history.new: 300 of 300 random cases with N <= 30 in the lab; the Skeptic checked all 1,997,716 affine magmas with beta a unit and 2 <= N <= 60 exhaustively - the maximal cycle length equals the lcm of all cycle lengths in every case, and that lcm equals the directly computed matrix order for N <= 24. Proven only when the pair map has a fixed point (CLM-C16-12); a partial proof idea from the review - if gamma is a unit, e_3 is a cyclic vector (det[e_3, A e_3, A^2 e_3] = -gamma^2).
history.old: 300 of 300 random cases with N <= 30. Proven only when the pair map has a fixed point (CLM-C16-12) - in general the matrix order is the lcm of all orbit lengths, and equality with the maximum needs a vector whose orbit attains the lcm.
history.reason: Skeptic review 2026-10-18 - exhaustive evidence to N = 60

statement: For every affine magma x*y = alpha x + beta y + gamma on Z/N with beta a unit, the maximal period of the pair map equals the order of [[0,1,0],[beta,alpha,gamma],[0,0,1]] mod N.
title: For affine magmas the maximal period equals the order of the 3x3 affine matrix
